processes.unmatched_meter_volume_deal_or_writeoff: Logistics identifies meter flow booked to the strangers gas contract and asks for a deal or approval to write the volumes off to unaccounted-for gas, then moves the volumes.
processes.meter_setup_and_nomination_anomaly_resol: Investigating and fixing meter or contract setup problems and unexpected nominations on meters so volumes can be run through the system.
processes.sitara_deal_entry_and_adjustment_request: Requests to enter, path, or adjust deals and demand charges in Sitara so volumes and dollars book correctly.
processes.counterparty_deal_rebooking_and_book_mov: Moving or rebooking deals to different books or counterparties after credit reports, terminations or bankruptcy, usually from lists sent to risk and book admins.
processes.trading_book_setup_access: Setting up books, counterparties, personnel and access in Tagg/Sitara and related systems, and identifying traders for books.
